title: oneisall 5G WiFi Automatic Cat Feeder for 2 Cats, App Control, 20 Cups/5L
say: Customers find the automatic feeder easy to set up and appreciate its user-friendly app that controls feeding schedules and portion sizes. The device helps maintain a consistent routine for pets, with one customer noting how it prevents bullying between cats. While some customers consider it worth the money, others find it overpriced, and while some report no WiFi connectivity issues, others experience frequent disconnections. The portion size receives mixed feedback, with some praising the portion sizes while others find them too small.
